text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 167, August 24, 1948 ]
PROVIDING FOR THE COORDINATION OF ALL NATIONAL INTELLIGENCE ACTIVITIES OF THE
GOVERNMENT
WHEREAS, it is proper at this time to provide for a central agency to coordinate the intelligence gathering
activities of the various branches and instrumentalities of the government;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, ELPIDIO QUIRINO, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in
me by the Constitution and laws of the Philippines, do hereby order that:
1. The President shall designate an officer of the Government as Coordinator of National Intelligence. He
shall be charged with the proper coordination of all government activities relating to national intelligence and
security, and with the preparation of national intelligence estimates.
2. All information relating to national security and intelligence obtained by or in the possession of agencies
under the Departments of Foreign Affairs, Interior, Justice, National Defense, Finance, and Labor, or other
branches or subdivisions of the national government, shall be referred to the Military Intelligence Service,
Armed Forces of the Philippines, for proper evaluation, interpretation, and dissemination to the appropriate
agency or agencies involved.
3. The Coordinator of National Intelligence is hereby authorized to call upon any department, bureau, or
office, agency or instrumentality of the government for such information and assistance as he may require in
the performance of his functions. The heads and chiefs of such agencies and instrumentalities shall comply
strictly with any such request.
4. This Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila this 24th day of August in the year of our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-eight,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the third.
(SGD.) ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(SGD.) EMILIO ABELLO
Executive Secretary
